description: Can I get out after I get in? Simulate a real buy and sell against a freshly launched Base token, read the owner powers left in its bytecode, and return both with the block they stop being true at. Paid per call with x402 on Base: $0.02 to $0.07 USDC depending on how much of the answer the network already has. Shared: reusing an answer another agent already paid for costs less, and the wallet that produced it earns a bounded credit.

address.description: Base token address to check before buying: simulates sell/exit via eth_call, verifies DEX LP reserves and burn/lock status, and inspects owner powers (mint, blacklist, pause, fee traps). Includes 1 free daily check per IP for testing; unlimited calls via x402 or prepaid tokens.
